sqlStatement:
WITH RankedItems AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [Item ID] ORDER BY [Mass Volume Size]) AS rn
  FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V]
  WHERE Company = 'rdsi'
)
SELECT
  ri.[Company], ri.[Buyer Group ID], ri.[Coverage Group ID], ri.[Dim Brand Name], ri.[Dim Business Unit Name],
  ri.[Dim Product Type Code], ri.[Item Group ID], ri.[Item Group Name], ri.[Item ID],
  pot.[External Part No], itm.UNITID AS 'UOM', ri.[Item Name], ri.[Item Type Description],
  ri.[Mass Volume Size], ri.[Mass Volume UOM], ri.[Master Code],
  CASE WHEN ri.ABCRevenueEnum = 3 THEN 'C' WHEN ri.ABCRevenueEnum = 2 THEN 'B' WHEN ri.ABCRevenueEnum = 1 THEN 'A' ELSE '0' END AS 'ABC',
  ri.[Shelf Life Days], ri.[Stopped], ri.[Supply Strategy Code] AS 'MTO/MTS', ri.[Supply Strategy Description],
  ri.[Unit of Measure], ri.[Unit Current Retail Price], ri.[Unit Price], ri.[Vendor], ri.[PRIMARYVENDORID],
  ri.[WebActive], ri.[Current Retail Price], ri.[NAMEALIAS], ri.[BATCHNUMGROUPID], ri.[PDSSHELFADVICE],
  ri.[PDSBESTBEFORE], ri.[COSTGROUPID], ri.[ITEMDIMCOSTPRICE], ri.[BOMUNITID], ri.[INTRACODE],
  ri.[PDSVendorCheckItem], ri.[PMFPRODUCTTYPE], ri.[ORIGCOUNTRYREGIONID], ri.[BOMCALCGROUPID],
  CASE WHEN ri.[Item Group ID] LIKE 'FG%' THEN 'FG' WHEN ri.[Item Group ID] LIKE 'INT%' THEN 'INT' WHEN ri.[Item Group ID] LIKE 'FRT%' THEN 'FRT' WHEN ri.[Item Group ID] LIKE 'RM%' THEN 'RM' ELSE ri.[Item Group ID] END AS 'Consolidated Item Group',
  CASE WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Plate%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Diluent%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Conj%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Standard%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Array%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Det%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Particle%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Control%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Access%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%Intermediate - Capture%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%FinGds - Duoset%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%FinGds - Multiplex%' THEN 'ASD Make' WHEN ri.[Item Group Name] LIKE '%FinGds - ELISA%' THEN 'ASD Make' ELSE 'Other' END AS 'ASD Make Item Group',
  CASE WHEN ri.[Stopped] = 'Yes' THEN 'Inactive' WHEN ri.[Buyer Group ID] = 'P99' THEN 'Inactive' WHEN ri.[Buyer Group ID] = 'P98' THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Active' END AS 'Active/Inactive',
  CASE WHEN it.PHANTOM = 0 THEN 'No' WHEN it.PHANTOM = 1 THEN 'Yes' END AS 'Phantom',
  it.PDSSHELFLIFE
FROM RankedItems ri
LEFT JOIN INVENTTABLEMODULE_V itm ON ri.[Item ID] = itm.ITEMID AND ri.Company = itm.DATAAREAID
LEFT JOIN [Purchase Order Transactions_V] pot ON ri.[Item ID] = pot.[Item ID] AND ri.PRIMARYVENDORID = pot.[Vendor Account]
LEFT JOIN INVENTTABLE_V it ON ri.[Item ID] = it.ITEMID AND ri.Company = it.DATAAREAID
WHERE rn=1 AND itm.MODULETYPE = 2
description: Retrieves comprehensive inventory/item master data with ABC classification, supply strategy, and pricing information. Filters for company 'rdsi' and performs deduplication on Item ID with row numbering.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
  it.[RECID], it.[Company], it.[Item ID], it.[Transaction Type],
  it.[Inventory Location ID], it.[Date Physical], it.[Issue Status],
  it.[Receipt Status], it.[Outbound Quantity],
  ito.[REFERENCEID], ijd.[Journal Name],
  ijd.[Journal Name Description]
FROM [dbo].[Inventory Transactions_V] it
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Inventory Trans Origin_V] ito
  ON it.[INVENTTRANSORIGIN] = ito.[RECID]
  AND it.[Company] = ito.[DATAAREAID]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Inventory Journal Document_V] ijd
  ON ito.[REFERENCEID] = ijd.[Journal ID]
  AND ito.[DATAAREAID] = ijd.[Company]
WHERE it.[Company] = 'rdsi'
  AND it.[Transaction Type] IN (0, 4, 8)
  AND it.[Inventory Location ID] IN ('BT', 'bt', 'BT-OPS')
  AND it.[Date Physical] >= '2024-01-01'
  AND (
    ijd.[Journal ID] IS NULL
    OR NOT (
      ijd.[Company] = 'rdsi'
      AND ((ijd.[Journal Name] = '5503000' AND ijd.[Journal Name Description] LIKE '%Scrapped Inventory (AX) - Raw Materials%')
           OR (ijd.[Journal Name] = '5503001' AND ijd.[Journal Name Description] LIKE '%Scrapped Inventory (AX)-Finished Goods%')
           OR (ijd.[Journal Name] = '5503002' AND ijd.[Journal Name Description] LIKE '%Scrapped Inventory (AX)-Intermediates%')
           OR (ijd.[Journal Name] = '5503005' AND ijd.[Journal Name Description] LIKE '%Scrapped Inventory (AX) Shipping Packaging%')
           OR (ijd.[Journal Name] = '5503020' AND ijd.[Journal Name Description] LIKE '%Obsolete (AX) - Raw Materials%')
           OR (ijd.[Journal Name] = '5503021' AND ijd.[Journal Name Description] LIKE '%Obsolete (AX) - Finished Goods%')
           OR (ijd.[Journal Name] = '5503022' AND ijd.[Journal Name Description] LIKE '%Obsolete (AX) - Intermediates%'))
    )
  )
ORDER BY it.[Date Physical] DESC
description: Retrieves 12-month rolling inventory transactions for planning purposes. Filters company 'rdsi', transaction types 0/4/8 (Sales Order/Transactions/Production Line), locations BT/BT-OPS, excludes scrapped/obsolete inventory through journal filtering, sorted by date descending.

sqlStatement:
SELECT BT.[ITEMGROUPID], BT.[ITEMID], BT.[INVENTSTATUSID], BT.[PDSSHELFLIFE], BT.[REQGROUPID],
  BT.[INVENTBATCHID], BT.[BESTBEFOREDATE], BT.[EXPDATE], BT.[BTMASSVOLUMEUOM],
  BT.[BTMASSVOLUME], BT.[STOPPED], BT.[ITEMDATAAREAID], BT.[INVENTSITEID],
  BT.[INVENTLOCATIONID], BT.[DISPOSITION], BT.[PHYSICALINVENTORY],
  BT.[ORDEREDINTOTAL], BT.[AVAILABLEPHYSICAL], BT.[RESERVPHYSICAL], BT.[ONORDER],
  it.[ITEMBUYERGROUPID]
FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BTOnHandInventoryView_V] BT
INNER JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[INVENTTABLE_V] AS it
  ON BT.[ITEMID] = it.[ITEMID]
  AND BT.[ITEMDATAAREAID] = it.[DATAAREAID]
WHERE BT.[ITEMDATAAREAID] = 'rdsi'
  AND BT.[INVENTLOCATIONID] IN('BT','BT-OPS','BT-STORES','CCD','CCD-OPS')
  AND [EXPDATE] >= GETDATE()
UNION
SELECT NULL, s.[ITEMID], NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
  s.[DATAAREAID], NULL, NULL, NULL, s.[PHYSICALINVENTORY], s.[ORDEREDINTOTAL],
  s.[AVAILABLEPHYSICAL], s.[RESERVPHYSICAL], s.[ONORDER], NULL
FROM (SELECT [ITEMID], [DATAAREAID], sum([AVAILPHYSICAL]), sum([PHYSICALINVENT]),
  sum([RESERVPHYSICAL]), sum([ONORDER]), sum([ORDERED])
  FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[INVENTSUM_V]
  WHERE [DATAAREAID]='rdsi'
  GROUP BY [ITEMID], [DATAAREAID]) s
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BTOnHandInventoryView_V]
  WHERE [ITEMDATAAREAID] = 'rdsi') b
  ON s.ITEMID = b.ITEMID
WHERE b.ITEMID IS NULL
description: Combines batch-controlled inventory from BTOnHandInventoryView with inventory summary (INVENTSUM) for non-batch controlled items. Filters company 'rdsi', locations BT/BT-OPS/BT-STORES/CCD, excludes expired items (EXPDATE >= today).

sqlStatement:
SELECT [DW_Id], [PRODID], [LINENUM], [PRODLINETYPE], [BOMCONSUMP], [ITEMID], [BOMQTY],
  [CONSTANT], [ROUNDUP], [ROUNDUPQTY], [OPRNUM], [QTYBOMCALC], [REMAINBOMPHYSICAL],
  [QTYINVENTCALC], [RAWMATERIALDATE], [REMAININVENTPHYSICAL], [INVENTREFTYPE],
  [INVENTREFID], [UNITID], [QTYINVENTSTUP], [QTYBOMSTUP], [BOMID], [FORMULA],
  [BOMREFRECID], [BOMQTYSERIE], [ITEMROUTEID], [ITEMBOMID], [INVENTDIMID],
  [REQPOID], [REQPLANIDSCHED], [RAWMATERIALTIME], [SCRAPVAR], [SCRAPCONST],
  [CONSTANTRELEASED], [ENDCONSUMP], [ENDSCHEDCONSUMP], [PROJCATEGORYID],
  [ACTIVITYNUMBER], [DEFAULTDIMENSION], [PROJTRANSID], [PROJTRANSDATE],
  [PROJLINEPROPERTYID], [PROJCOSTPRICE], [PROJCOSTAMOUNT], [PROJSALESCURRENCYID],
  [PROJSALESPRICE], [PROJTAXGROUPID], [PROJTAXITEMGROUPID], [PROJID],
  [PROJSETSUBPRODTOCONSUMED], [PRICE_RU], [PRICEUNIT_RU], [LINEAMOUNT_RU],
  [PDSBASEVALUE], [PDSCWINVENTCALC], [PDSCWINVENTSTUP], [PDSCWQTY],
  [PDSCWREMAINFINANCIAL], [PDSCWREMAINPHYSICAL], [PDSINGREDIENTTYPE],
  [PDSINHERITCOPRODUCTBATCHATTRIB], [PDSINHERITCOPRODUCTSHELFLIFE],
  [PDSINHERITENDITEMBATCHATTRIB], [PDSINHERITENDITEMSHELFLIFE], [PMFFORMULAPCT],
  [PMFPCTENABLE], [PMFQTYWITHOUTYIELD], [PMFSCALABLE], [DATAAREAID],
  [RECVERSION], [PARTITION], [RECID], [DW_Batch], [DW_SourceCode], [DW_TimeStamp]
FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[ProdBom_V]
WHERE DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
  AND REMAINBOMPHYSICAL <> 0
description: Retrieves production bill of materials data (BOM lines) for all raw materials. Filters company 'rdsi' with non-zero remaining physical component quantities.
Retrieves planning parameters and coverage settings for items. Filters company 'rdsi'.

sqlStatement:
SELECT BV.[BOMID] AS 'Parent Number', BV.[ITEMID] AS 'Line Part',
  BV.[BOMQTY] AS 'BOM Lines Qty', BV.[OPRNUM] AS 'Oper. Num.',
  BV.[UNITID] AS 'UOM', BV.[ITEMBOMID], BV.[DATAAREAID],
  BVV.NAME, BVV.FROMDATE, BVV.FROMQTY,
  CASE WHEN BVV.ACTIVE = 0 THEN 'No' WHEN BVV.ACTIVE = 1 THEN 'Yes' END AS 'ACTIVE',
  BVV.RECID, BT.[ITEMGROUPID], H.PERSONNELNUMBER AS 'APPROVER',
  BT.[SITEID] AS 'Site',
  CASE WHEN BT.[APPROVED] = 0 THEN 'No' WHEN BT.[APPROVED] = 1 THEN 'Yes' END AS 'APPROVED',
  IV.[Item Name] AS 'Product Name', H.[Employee Name] AS 'Approver Name',
  CASE WHEN BV.BOMQTYSERIE = 0 THEN NULL ELSE BV.BOMQTY / BV.BOMQTYSERIE END AS 'Conversion Factor',
  IV.[Item Type Description]
FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IV
LEFT JOIN BOM_V BV ON BV.ITEMID = IV.[Item ID] AND BV.DATAAREAID = IV.Company
LEFT JOIN BOMVERSION_V BVV ON BV.BOMID = BVV.BOMID AND BVV.DATAAREAID = BV.DATAAREAID
LEFT JOIN BOMTABLE_V BT ON BV.BOMID = BT.BOMID AND BT.DATAAREAID = BV.DATAAREAID
LEFT JOIN HCMWORKER_V H ON H.RECID = BT.APPROVER
WHERE IV.Company = 'rdsi'
  AND BV.ITEMID <> 'NULL'
ORDER BY BV.[BOMID]
description: Returns detailed bill of materials structure with BOM versions, approvers, and approval status. Filters company 'rdsi' and item types equal to 'Item'. Includes conversion factors and site information.
Retrieves item codes with purchase and standard units of measure from accounting system. Removes duplicate ItemCode records.

sqlStatement:
SELECT [ItemCode], [WarehouseCode], [TransactionDate], [TransactionCode],
  ABS(Sum([TransactionQty])) as 'Transaction Quantity'
FROM [MAS90CBS].[dbo].[IM_ItemTransactionHistory]
WHERE [TransactionCode] = 'BI'
  AND WarehouseCode IN('000','C01','C02','C03','SPW','200')
  AND TransactionDate >= DATEADD(DAY, -365, GETDATE())
  AND TransactionQty <> 0
GROUP BY [ItemCode], [WarehouseCode], [TransactionDate], [TransactionCode]
description: Aggregates inventory transactions (opening balance 'BI' code) from past 365 days for specified warehouses. Groups by item, warehouse, and date with absolute sum of quantities.
Retrieves warehouse inventory balances and reorder methods from accounting system. Filters only items with positive on-hand quantities.

sqlStatement:
WITH BaseKitList AS (SELECT 'LUHM000' AS Kit UNION ALL SELECT 'LMPM000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LOBM000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LHSCM000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LBAM000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LBHS000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LHK000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LTGM00' UNION ALL SELECT 'LUXLM000B' UNION ALL SELECT 'LMET000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LMXL000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LNHPXL000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LHION000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LHTM000' UNION ALL SELECT 'LMXTRAINING' UNION ALL SELECT 'NONALX01' UNION ALL SELECT 'NONALX02' UNION ALL SELECT 'NONALX03'),
ItemList AS (SELECT DISTINCT IV.[Item ID] AS ItemID FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IV WHERE IV.[Company] = 'rdsi' AND IV.[Buyer Group ID] = 'P19' AND [Supply Strategy Code] = 'MTS' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BaseKitList B WHERE B.Kit = IV.[Item ID]) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOM_V] BV WHERE BV.[BOMID] = IV.[Item ID] AND BV.[DATAAREAID] = 'rdsi')),
KitScope AS (SELECT Kit AS KitID FROM BaseKitList UNION SELECT ItemID AS KitID FROM ItemList),
AllLuminexKits AS (SELECT DISTINCT KS.KitID AS Kit, IV.[Item Name] AS KitName FROM KitScope KS LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IV ON IV.[Item ID] = KS.KitID AND IV.[Company] = 'rdsi'),
KitClassified AS (SELECT K.Kit, K.KitName, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BaseKitList B WHERE B.Kit = K.Kit) THEN 'Base Kit' ELSE 'Other' END AS [Kit Type] FROM AllLuminexKits K),
BomRows AS (SELECT KC.Kit AS [Parent Number], KC.KitName AS [NAME], KC.[Kit Type], BV.[ITEMID] AS [Line Part], IVLP.[Item Name] AS [Product Name], BV.[BOMQTY] AS [BOM Lines Qty], CASE WHEN BV.[BOMQTYSERIE] = 0 THEN NULL ELSE BV.[BOMQTY] * 1.0 / BV.[BOMQTYSERIE] END AS [Conversion Factor], IVLP.PDSBESTBEFORE AS [Best Before Period (Days)], IVLP.[Shelf Life Days] AS [Shelf Life (Days)] FROM KitClassified KC LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOM_V] BV ON BV.[BOMID] = KC.Kit AND BV.[DATAAREAID] = 'rdsi' LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOMVERSION_V] BVV ON BVV.[BOMID] = BV.[BOMID] AND BVV.[DATAAREAID] = BV.[DATAAREAID] LEFT JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOMTABLE_V] BT ON BT.[BOMID] = BV.[BOMID] AND BT.[DATAAREAID] = BV.[DATAAREAID] AND BT.[SITEID] IN ('BT','BT-OPS') INNER JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IVLP ON IVLP.[Item ID] = BV.[ITEMID] AND IVLP.[Company] = 'rdsi' AND IVLP.[Buyer Group ID] = 'P19' WHERE BV.[ITEMID] IS NOT NULL),
NoBomKits AS (SELECT KC.Kit AS [Parent Number], KC.KitName AS [NAME], KC.[Kit Type], KC.Kit AS [Line Part], KC.KitName AS [Product Name], CAST(1 AS decimal(18,6)) AS [BOM Lines Qty], CAST(1 AS decimal(18,6)) AS [Conversion Factor], IVLP.PDSBESTBEFORE AS [Best Before Period (Days)], IVLP.[Shelf Life Days] AS [Shelf Life (Days)] FROM KitClassified KC INNER JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IVLP ON IVLP.[Item ID] = KC.Kit AND IVLP.[Company] = 'rdsi' AND IVLP.[Buyer Group ID] = 'P19' WHERE KC.Kit <> 'LHK000' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[BOM_V] BV WHERE BV.[BOMID] = KC.Kit AND BV.[DATAAREAID] = 'rdsi')),
LHK000_Hardcoded AS (SELECT 'LHK000' AS [Parent Number], (SELECT TOP 1 KitName FROM KitClassified WHERE Kit = 'LHK000') AS [NAME], 'Base Kit' AS [Kit Type], v.[Line Part], IVLP.[Item Name] AS [Product Name], CAST(1 AS decimal(18,6)) AS [BOM Lines Qty], CAST(1 AS decimal(18,6)) AS [Conversion Factor], IVLP.PDSBESTBEFORE AS [Best Before Period (Days)], IVLP.[Shelf Life Days] AS [Shelf Life (Days)] FROM (VALUES ('895970'), ('894311'), ('895986'), ('895529'), ('892525')) v([Line Part]) INNER JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IVLP ON IVLP.[Item ID] = v.[Line Part] AND IVLP.[Company] = 'rdsi' AND IVLP.[Buyer Group ID] = 'P19'),
ScreeningStandards_Hardcoded AS (...) SELECT * FROM BomRows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM NoBomKits UNION ALL SELECT * FROM LHK000_Hardcoded UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ScreeningStandards_Hardcoded ORDER BY [Parent Number], [Line Part]
description: Complex BOM structure query that defines base kits (hardcoded list) and other kits (derived from Buyer Group P19 with MTS supply strategy). Returns complete kit-component mapping with hardcoded exceptions for LHK000 and Screening Standards. Orders by parent and line part.

sqlStatement:
SELECT A.*, B.[Buyer Group ID]
FROM (SELECT * FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[SALESLINE_V]
  WHERE [DATAAREAID] = 'rdsi'
  AND [SALESSTATUS] = 1) A
INNER JOIN (SELECT [Item ID], [Buyer Group ID] FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V]
  WHERE Company = 'rdsi') B
  ON A.ITEMID = B.[Item ID]
description: Retrieves open sales line details (SALESSTATUS = 1) for company 'rdsi' with item buyer group information joined from item master.

sqlStatement:
SELECT d.[PurchaseOrderNo], d.[LineKey], d.[LineSeqNo], d.[ItemCode],
  d.[ItemCodeDesc], d.[RequiredDate], d.[UnitOfMeasure],
  d.[QuantityOrdered] * d.[UnitOfMeasureConvFactor] AS 'QuantityOrdered',
  d.[QuantityReceived] * d.[UnitOfMeasureConvFactor] AS 'QuantityReceived',
  d.[UDF_COMMITDATE], d.[UDF_REVISEDDELIVERYDATE],
  (d.QuantityOrdered - d.QuantityReceived) * d.[UnitOfMeasureConvFactor] AS 'Open Bal',
  h.WarehouseCode,
  CASE WHEN d.ItemCode LIKE '*%' THEN 'Indirect' ELSE 'Direct' END AS 'Direct/Indirect'
FROM [MAS90CBS].[dbo].[PO_PurchaseOrderDetail] d
LEFT JOIN PO_PurchaseOrderHeader h ON d.PurchaseOrderNo = h.PurchaseOrderNo
WHERE (d.QuantityOrdered - d.QuantityReceived) > 0
description: Retrieves open purchase order details with open balance calculations. Converts quantities using UnitOfMeasureConvFactor. Classifies items as Direct/Indirect based on ItemCode pattern.

sqlStatement:
WITH ComponentRef AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Standards', 1, 2), ('Controls', 1, 2), ('Biotin cocktail', 1, 1), ('Streptavidin-PE', 1, 1), ... ) v([Component Category], [IsMatchSet], [QtyPerKit])),
Component_Category AS (SELECT CASE WHEN [Item Name] LIKE '%Standard Cocktail 1%' THEN 'Standards' ... END AS [Component Category], [Buyer Group ID], [Item Group ID], [Item Group Name], [Item ID], [Item Name] FROM [dbo].[Item_V] WHERE [Company] = 'rdsi')
SELECT CASE WHEN r.IsMatchSet = 1 THEN 'Match Set Component' WHEN r.IsMatchSet = 0 THEN 'Not Match Set Component' ELSE 'Not Match Set Component' END AS [Match Set?], c.[Item Group ID], c.[Item Group Name], c.[Item ID], c.[Item Name], c.[Component Category], r.[QtyPerKit]
FROM Component_Category c
LEFT JOIN ComponentRef r ON r.[Component Category] = c.[Component Category]
WHERE r.[Component Category] IS NOT NULL
description: Classifies inventory items into match set components using pattern matching on item names. Maps items to component categories (Standards, Controls, Biotin cocktail, etc.) and indicates match set status with quantity per kit.
